name: t1.0/k64
why: Measured on the 6 probes that actually spiral, 2 passes each, budget 8000: t=0.6/k20 (Qwen own thinking recommendation) answered 4/12 for 78066 tokens; t=0.8/k20 7/12 for 79952; t=1.0/k64 10/12 for 64379. Hotter is both more reliable and cheaper here, because a spiral burns the whole budget and returns nothing. Greedy is unusable: doubling the budget 8000->16000 at t=0 doubled 5 of 6 traces instead of letting them finish. No trace cap is available -- reasoning_effort, max_thinking_tokens and template thinking_budget are all accepted and silently ignored.
